title: Deadbands and constants
summary: Stopping a drifting stick from creeping the robot.

steps.title: Sticks drift
steps.say: Real sticks never rest at exactly 0.0. A tiny 0.03 would make the robot creep. A **deadband** treats small values as zero.

steps.title: A constant
steps.say: Give the number a name, at the top of the class. `final` means it never changes.

marks.label: a name instead of a mystery 0.1

steps.title: The if
steps.say: `Math.abs` ignores the sign, so one check covers both directions.

steps.title: Open Robot.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Robot` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find DEADBAND
steps.say: It's in teleopPeriodic. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `DEADBAND` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: STEP 4
steps.say: Add the constant at the top of the class, then the two `if`s here.
